question: Does deterministic full-order twist-generator selection change exact finite-base completeness relative to the archived first-point rule?

claims.text: Exact native/CAS source/twist orders and canonical seed selection agree on all ten original fixtures.
All 120 complete base sets agree independently, including sixty archived baseline sets and forty zero-shift controls.
No cost, scalar transfer, NIST security, novelty or whole-IC gain is established by construction counts.

arms.description: Actual native target-blind generator discovery and complete construction panel.

Actual independent PARI replay of all cardinalities, canonical seeds, orders, base sets and fill aggregates. GP script is generated from the same frozen repository source; the prebuilt CAS engine has its own binary hash.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact complete finite count, no performance or sampling inference.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No separate experimental arm: known source-generator orders and pre-data p7 native/GP controls are embedded correctness checks, not performance observations.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No separate experimental arm: all forty zero-shift sets must be empty; a nonmultiple-order p7 unit control must be rejected.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: Pinned native field/group binary and independent PARI engine; generated GP script source is frozen with native source.
factors.how: Record source/binary hashes before data; reopen raw hashes.

factors.name: inputs
factors.value: All original ten fixtures; both strategies; c=0,1,3 and B8/B16; selection reads no target, shift, size or yield.
factors.how: Complete finite exhaustion; never infer prefix mixing from full-universe density.

factors.name: host
factors.value: Same local L0 managed host; no native clock or cost admitted.

factors.name: analyst
factors.value: Shared author and host, deterministic exact equality only.
factors.how: Independent code, square-table finite census, GP factor controls and Lean sign identity.

comparisons.threshold: Exact all ten orders/seeds and all120 complete-base equalities; all controls; native/CAS fill aggregates identical.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Native producer then independent PARI replay; exact count comparison only, no clock or performance.

seed_derivation.note: Deterministic fixed input panel and exhaustive shifts; seed field zero is metadata only.

instance_sampling.rule: One complete fixed panel with120 constructions; two actual whole-panel executions, not120 independent targets.

blinding.how: Exact finite verification only; no statistical or comparative claim.

power.note: Exact complete finite counts and necessary-factor checks, not statistical inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Unmeasured prospective watchdog envelope;600s native,300s CAS plus admission/metadata allowance. No performance observation.

primary.name: Complete finite base constructions
primary.unit: construction cases in the fixed panel
primary.definition: Both canonical seeds, all ten fixtures, shifts0/1/3 and B8/B16; complete sorted sets, including underfilled and empty controls.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly ten fixture seed/order cases and120 complete base constructions; fail explicitly if a full-order seed is absent or a stage hits its cap. No outcome-dependent enlargement/refill.

decision_rule.text: Admit exact cardinality, order, seed, full-base and aggregate equality plus embedded controls; no speedup or scalar-map verdict.
decision_rule.statistic: Complete finite construction counts and group orders.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Filled bases among forty nonzero cases per seed strategy; different answer sets, not same-output speed.

inputs: actual GP receipt and output hashes

graphs: Recorded native/CAS-verified generator orders and finite-fill counts; no invented cost axis.

inadmissible: Calling different coordinate sets a same-output speedup
Interpreting rational twist generators as a scalar-preserving source map
Ignoring discovery, failed fills or zero-shift controls
Claiming IC/rho or NIST benefit from toy construction counts
Changing selection using targets, shifts, sizes or observed yield

literature.claim: Pre-data repository/atlas/field-source review and local primary PARI ellorder/ellcard help, with noncohort p7 controls.
literature.verified_by: Read before source/selection and panel freeze.

extensions.backend_authority: Standing user authorization; documented EKS access/local fallback. No new paid resource.
